## Marcel Santos

### Tenure

[2016](/wiki/2016) – [2017](/wiki/2017)

**Marcel Santos** is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked with the company from 2016 to 2017. Santos mainly worked on the [Hot Wheels City](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_City) line of playsets as well as some vehicle work. The Super Ultimate Garage won Toy Of The Year in the Playsets category in 2018. He is currently an Industrial Designer at Walt Disney Imagineering.
